title: First German Psychotherapist Barometer: A Nationwide Survey of Outpatient Psychotherapists
summary: The First German Psychotherapist Barometer aims to create a representative picture of outpatient psychotherapeutic care in Germany from a psychotherapy research centered perspective. To this end, outpatient psychotherapists of all therapeutic orientations across the country will be surveyed. Guiding research questions include: What do psychotherapists in Germany think and feel about certain work-related issues in their daily professional life? Which personal values and attitudes play a role in the profession of psychotherapy? What attitudes and experiences exist regarding specific patient groups? Can a current state of outpatient psychotherapeutic care be determined, and how is it assessed by practitioners?
conditions: Therapist variables, healthcare issues in outpatient psychotherapeutic practice

interventions.name: Single-arm, non-interventional panel study (observational study) targeting outpatient psychotherapists practicing across Germany. The study explores various relevant topics in psychotherapy and mental healthcare research.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Outpatient psychotherapists practicing in Germany (according to the KBV register)
Exclusion criteria:
Psychotherapists not engaged in outpatient practice
